title: The Return v4 (v1 sound, fuller rhythm, a touch of Indian)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: Epic modern South Indian cinematic hero-introduction score, instrumental. A hero returns to his city after many years. Same core sound as a modern film score: strings, brass, deep drums, distorted electric guitar, sub-bass; with a light touch of Indian colour (nadaswaram lead, a little tabla, mridangam, thavil, veena and sitar fills, bansuri at the end), not too much. Mode: fierce heroic minor with a raised fourth, in the mood of Carnatic Raga Shanmukhapriya; one 4-note heroic motif that keeps returning. Busy and continuous all the way through: a steady rhythm in every second, dense melodic movement, every gap filled with ostinatos, drum patterns and short melodic answers; no silence, no lone drones, no long held pauses. 0-12 s: drone and sub pad with a soft pulsing kick and ticking tabla from the first beat, the nadaswaram states the motif and a veena answers each phrase. 12-30 s: heartbeat kick at 70 BPM, low string ostinato in steady walking steps, mridangam and shaker groove, cello carries the motif without rests, sitar fills between phrases. 30-45 s: thavil and frame-drum rolls build, brass swells, the motif climbs higher every bar. 45-47 s: a fast drum fill and riser straight into the drop, no silence. 47-70 s: massive drop with thundering drums, brass stabs and distorted electric guitar, dhol and thavil drive a Tamil folk dance groove at 140 BPM, the nadaswaram plays the full heroic theme over constant string runs. 70-80 s: the motif on bansuri over a soft tabla groove and a held chord, ending on a long held note. Wide cinematic stereo, deep sub-bass, punchy drums, analogue warmth. Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no chanting, no spoken words.

brief.raga: Shanmukhapriya (Carnatic melakarta 56): fierce and heroic, minor colour with a raised 4th (prati madhyamam). The hero motif is 4 notes: Sa, Ri, Ga (minor), then a leap to the raised Ma, held.
brief.tempo: 70 BPM in half-time for the walk, felt as 140 BPM after the drop
brief.lead: nadaswaram (the hero's voice), with solo cello and bansuri for memory

brief.notes: Jithesh 28 Oct: v1's sound is the one; v3 (all Indian) was wrong. Keep v1, add a few Indian instruments as colour only, more rhythm and more notes, fill every gap (no silence, no lone drone).

story: A hero walks back into his city after many years away. The city half-remembers him; then the whole street knows he is back.
